sources.label: the keyword map (which page owns which search)
the SEO method (Wedding SEO Bootcamp, in our words)

does: Every Monday, reads Google Search Console for all 12 of our sites, last 28 days against the 28 before
Finds the quick wins: searches where we sit on page 2 to 5, and page-1 results nobody clicks
Rewrites the SEO title and description for each of those pages, from the title and description really on the page today
Catches two of our own pages competing for the same search, and says which page should own it
Flags pages that dropped 5 or more places, and hands Bloggy Bob ready-to-run requests for new posts

traits.cant: Change a page, a title or a setting on a site
traits.instead: Writes the exact new title and description; a person pastes them in WordPress or Squarespace

traits.cant: Give search volumes or keyword difficulty
traits.instead: Works from Search Console, which shows what people actually searched to find us; volumes come once an SEO tool is connected
Hands Bloggy Bob the keyword, the site and the post type, ready to run
